title: Every closed subset of a scheme underlies a closed subscheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $T\subseteq X$ a closed subset. Then there are a scheme $Y$ and a closed immersion $j:Y\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose image $j(Y)$ is $T$ (for instance the reduced induced closed subscheme structure on $T$).

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 26.12.4 (Tag 01J3, label lemma-reduced-closed-subscheme): there is a unique reduced closed subscheme with underlying space $T$; this node keeps the existence of some closed subscheme with underlying set $T$
